newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:
In answer to a question spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said there would be an extraordinary Telecoms Council on Wednesday to discuss postal services.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1173: Protection of human health was priority in BSE policy.
- IP/96/1179: Free movement of persons: four infringement procedures against France.
- IP/96/1180: Smoking in public places: Commission adopts a report.
- Speech/96/333: Extracts from Commissioner Mario Monti's speech on the internal market, competitiveness and employment.
- World Trade Organisation: Singapore ministerial declaration.
